onboarding_subtitle: Taui mwin am bwainaoraki, am appointment ma te taokita ke te kiriniki, ao tiokam, n English ke n Taetae ni Kiribati.
medications_empty: Ko tuai ni karin am bwainaoraki.
medication_dosage_hint: n aron 500 mg, teuana te tabure
medication_cap_reached_body: Ko kona ni kawakini batin aika 20 n te tai teuana. Kanakoa teuana imwain ae kona karina ae boou.
medication_delete_confirm: Ko kani kamaunaa te batin aei ao ni katoki ana kauring?
appointments_empty: Akea am appointment ma te taokita ke ma am kiriniki.
appointment_delete_confirm: Ko kani kamaunaa te appointment aei ao ni katoka ana kauring?
blood_sugar_empty: Akea mwin tiokam n ara rekoti.
blood_sugar_delete_confirm: Ko kani kamaunaa mwiin tiokam aio?
band_prediabetes: Ea kan reke te tioka iroum
advice_disclaimer: Aikai bon ti taeka ni bau aika a tabangaki ao aki onei mwin aia reirei taokita ma neeti.
settings_update_check_failed: E aki kona n tiroaki te update -- kotea bwa ko na manga kataia
feedback_intro: Buokira ni karaoiroa te app aei. Tuangira baika a raraoi ke baika a kona ni katamaroaki.
feedback_empty_error: Taiaoka korei moa am iango imwain ae ko kanakoa.
feedback_sent_title: E a Tia n Nako Am Iango
feedback_sent_body: E a tia ni kanakoaki am iango ni katamaroa n te i-meeri. Ko rabwa!
feedback_failed_body: Ti aki kona ni kaukia am i-meera ibukin kanakoan am katamaroa.
medication_notification_title: Ea bo am tai ni bwatin
medication_log_empty: Akea kanoana -- e na kaonaki ngkana ko kotea "Pills Taken" iaon te kauring.
settings_ask_reminder: Butiia temanna bwa e na kauringko
manage_caregivers_empty: Akea temanna ae e a tia n karinaki bwa te tia buobuoki. Karina temanna ae kona ni buokiko ni kauringko tain am bwatim.
caregiver_no_contact_info: Akea contact aika a tia ni karinaki
caregiver_delete_confirm: Ko kani kanakoa te tia buokiko aei?
alert_caregiver_title: Butiia temanna bwa e na kauringai
alert_caregiver_intro: Aei e na kaukia te app are ko rineia ma te rongorongo n kauring ae tauraoi ni kanakoaki -- ko na kotea send ngkana e a uki.
alert_caregiver_no_caregivers: Ko tuai n karina aran ae ena buobuoki. Nakon Settings ao ko karinna moa.
caregiver_message_generic: Mauri, aei bon te kauring ibukin buokau kauringau tain au bwainaoraki. E kanakoaki man te app ae Nima-am-Bwatin.
caregiver_message_with_medication: Mauri {name}, aei bon te kauring ibukin buokau kauringau tain au bwainaoraki. E kanakoaki man te app ae Nima-am-Bwatin.
caregiver_sent_email: E a tia ni kaukaki ana i-meeri {name} -- rinea send ikekei.
caregiver_sent_whatsapp: E a tia ni kaukaki ana WhatsApp {name} -- rinea send ikekei.
caregiver_sent_messenger: E a tia ni katotongaki te rongorongo. Paste ngkana e uki ana chat {name} nte Messenger.
caregiver_failed_generic: E aki kona ni kaukaki te app arei. Tuoi mwin ana bwai n reitaki ake ko kawakini ibukin {name}.
permission_exact_alarm_title: Kariaia te Tai ni kauring ae Koaua
permission_exact_alarm_body: Bwa e aonga n roko kauringam ibukin am bwainaoraki ao am appointment n te tai ae eti, taiaoka kariaia te app aei bwa e na baeirei kauring aika koaua i aon te screen ae na oti imwina.
permission_notifications_body: E kainnanoaki mairoun te app aei te kariaia bwa e na kanakoa nakoim kauring ibukin am bwainaoraki ao am appointments.
export_intro: Am bwainaoraki, am appointment, ao am mwin rietatan raram a kawakinaki tii nte tereboon aei. Ngkana e bua te tereboon aei, ko kaboua am tereboon, ke ko manga karina riki te app aei, e na aki kona ni manga kaokaki te rongorongom aikai ma tii ngkana iai am backup n aron aei.
export_recovery_note: Bwa e na manga kaokaki n taina imwina, kawakina te file ae e a tia ni kanakoaki n te tabo ae raoiroi (i-meera, Drive, kompiuta). Imwina, i aon te tereboon ae boou, kauka Settings > "Kaoki rongorongo man te rikoti are ko kaawakina" ao rinea te file arei.
export_success: E nakoraoi ao eti raoi kanakoan rongorongom.
export_error: Iai kangaanga ngke e kanakoaki rongorongom.
import_confirm_replace: Kaokan rongorongom aei ena kamaunai kanoana ao rongorongom ni kabane aika mena ngkai n te app. Continue?
import_success: E nakoraoi ao eti raoi kaokan rongorongom.
import_error: E aki kona ni kaokaki te file aei. Taiaoka taraia bwa eti raoi te file.
